end.summary:
Kavya discussed Diwali, Christmas, Baisakhi, Onam, and Bihu.
They described Diwali with crackers and sweets, and Christmas with cake and decorations.
They identified that regions celebrate different festivals and may celebrate the same festival differently.
They were not yet able to describe regional festival foods, clothes, decorations, and flowers independently.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised describing festival celebrations and noticing that festivals vary across regions and homes. They gave examples involving Diwali crackers and Christmas cake and tree decorations, and later explained that different families may celebrate differently. Baisakhi’s season and celebration details were mixed up or uncertain and were not fully corrected in the lesson. At home, ask Kavya to choose one festival and make four notes: food, clothes, decorations, and flowers.
